d: Polly is a humanoid plush doll.

footUpperSize.d: Size of the foot on the anthro legs

totalSize.d: Basic scale for the whole doll

helpText.d: Add letters and notes to matching curves

paperlessCurves.d: Add extra information to paperless view

faceType.d: Switch between different ways to assemble the face

faceType.split.d: Draft a face with a curved seam down the center

faceType.mirrored.d: Draft a face in one symmetrical piece

faceType.snout.d: Draft a face with a protruding snout for animal characters

faceType.hairline.d: Draft a face with separate pieces for faux fur hair

legFlare.d: Flares out the bottom of the cylindrical legs

legLength.d: Lengthens or shortens the cylindrical legs

legType.d: Switch between different ways to assemble the legs

legType.cylinder.d: Basic tube legs, simple to sew

legType.anthro.d: Stylized digitigrade legs for animal characters

proportionPreview.d: Draws a digital homunculus to show you the scale and proportions of the finished doll. Note: Scales on this are approximate
